name: Audited Unseen-Regime Online Adaptation + Additive Dynamic Residual Experts

executed_scope.description: Exposure Ledger + Temporal Cascade data-only pilot + U3/U4/causal-learnability audit (protocol §41: the single most useful next piece of work)
explicitly_not_done: no EAGate threshold tuning, no expert-count tuning
no offline adaptation on the unseen data
no dynamic expert D run (blocked until fixed C shows learning, §12/H3)

online_start_checkpoint.verified_by: exposure_ledger.json + protected_checkpoint_hashes.json + R1 configuration.json (recomputed during P21-S1)

regime.contract: CPU burst (age 0 familiar for placeability, ages 1..d at >= host CPU capacity) -> RAM target ramp at age +4 (progressive, released) -> capped self-cleaning retained disk term at age +8

pilot_registration.cohort_evidence: artifacts/ftmoe_online/protocol_020/vm_split.json cohorts.online (94 VMs, disjoint from S6 train 277 and dev 86); protocol §8.4 authorises this cohort subject to that disjointness
pilot_registration.selection_rule: candidates compared only on data physics / event structure (§7.1); model scores never consulted

requirements: cross-resource lag peak (CPU_t -> RAM_t+4 or CPU_t -> Disk_t+8) outside the historical 95% range of every auditable offline corpus
cascade transition probability differs from the offline maximum by >= 0.15 absolute or >= 1.5x
exact scoring-window hash overlap with P20 S6 adaptation = 0

learnability_gate.split: temporal only: 0-399 fit, 400-799 dev, 800-1199 held-forward (no shuffle)

stop_conditions.STOP-A: U3 not proven or U4 shows no real difference -> may not run models under the unseen name
stop_conditions.STOP-B: causal probe near prevalence/random baseline -> fix observability first
stop_conditions.STOP-C: fixed C not better than A on >= 2 of 3 dev replays -> no formal D
stop_conditions.STOP-D: any non-continuous alpha/topology boundary -> D ineligible
stop_conditions.STOP-E: candidate trained on its own qualification labels -> run void
stop_conditions.STOP-F: confirmation data used for selection -> stream demoted to development
